title: Name input label and on-theme toasts
acceptance: The collector name input has an accessible name 'Your name' (aria-label) with no layout change; placeholder kept; unit test by label

Normal toasts use the app's tokens (popover surface, foreground text, border, primary Undo button, matching close button) instead of sonner's built-in black/white dark palette; contrast meets AA for text and the Undo button; done via sonner's supported CSS variables/classNames, not !important
Toast position, duration, copy, closeButton, richColors semantics (success/error variants) and e2e-visible roles/text unchanged
Before/after screenshots of the pin toast (vault-pinned scene) at 390 and 320. NOT MET AT 320x568: the 320 capture is 320x844 (vault-pinned-320.png); no 320x568 pair was taken.

notes.text: Review of 17f2a5e..045c7e2: APPROVE. Screenshots viewed: pin toast before/after 390, trade success toast before/after 390. Cyan Undo kept global (judged legible on the success toast; fallback = scope to normal toasts). Unverified: success/error/neutral variants beyond the Declined toast, 320x568, real phone, Undo click, 44px close hit area on a thumb. Minor: --normal-bg-hover is a literal oklch.

NOT FULLY REVIEWED. The approve verdict stands for the code, but these were never verified: the 320x568 pin-toast view, measured AA contrast ratios for toast text and the Undo button (judged by eye only), an Undo click, and a real phone.
